tracks.srt_text:
1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:05,225
Two and a half kilometres down, there is no sunlight at all.

2
00:00:05,475 --> 00:00:09,024
The water here sits at about two degrees Celsius.

3
00:00:09,274 --> 00:00:15,160
And yet, crowded around cracks in the seafloor, there are animals everywhere.

4
00:00:15,410 --> 00:00:19,090
These cracks are hydrothermal vents.

5
00:00:19,340 --> 00:00:22,380
Seawater seeps into the crust,

6
00:00:22,630 --> 00:00:25,470
is heated by magma below,

7
00:00:25,720 --> 00:00:28,440
and comes roaring back out.

8
00:00:30,162 --> 00:00:32,645
At the orifice of a black smoker

9
00:00:32,895 --> 00:00:36,862
the fluid can reach about four hundred degrees Celsius —

10
00:00:37,112 --> 00:00:38,908
it does not boil,

11
00:00:39,158 --> 00:00:45,382
because the pressure at this depth is roughly two hundred and fifty times the pressure at the surface.

12
00:00:45,632 --> 00:00:48,912
The black smoke is not smoke:

13
00:00:49,162 --> 00:00:53,122
it is metal sulphide minerals crystallising

14
00:00:53,372 --> 00:00:56,212
the instant the hot fluid

15
00:00:56,462 --> 00:00:59,342
hits near-freezing seawater.

16
00:01:00,348 --> 00:01:02,478
Nothing here photosynthesises.

17
00:01:02,728 --> 00:01:05,697
Instead, bacteria use chemosynthesis:

18
00:01:05,947 --> 00:01:13,050
they oxidise the hydrogen sulphide streaming out of the vent to get energy, and use that energy to fix carbon dioxide into sugars.

19
00:01:13,300 --> 00:01:15,687
Sunlight is replaced by chemistry.

20
00:01:15,937 --> 00:01:20,708
The giant tubeworm Riftia pachyptila takes this one step further.

21
00:01:20,958 --> 00:01:23,763
An adult has no mouth and no gut.

22
00:01:24,013 --> 00:01:28,002
Inside its body is an organ packed with these bacteria,

23
00:01:28,252 --> 00:01:31,204
and the worm supplies them with hydrogen sulphide,

24
00:01:31,454 --> 00:01:35,534
oxygen and carbon dioxide carried in its blood.

25
00:01:35,784 --> 00:01:39,344
The bacteria feed the worm in return.

26
00:01:39,594 --> 00:01:42,394
Neither one survives alone —

27
00:01:42,644 --> 00:01:45,484
this is symbiosis.

28
00:01:45,734 --> 00:01:50,054
From those bacteria the food web climbs:

29
00:01:50,304 --> 00:01:53,024
tubeworms and mussels,

30
00:01:53,274 --> 00:01:56,674
then crabs and shrimp that graze on them,

31
00:01:56,924 --> 00:01:59,604
then fish at the top.

32
00:02:00,672 --> 00:02:03,512
An entire ecosystem,

33
00:02:03,762 --> 00:02:06,122
in permanent darkness,

34
00:02:06,372 --> 00:02:08,652
running on chemistry

35
00:02:08,902 --> 00:02:12,022
from the planet's own interior.
